data.title: Milestone Residences
data.about:
Immerse yourself in unparalleled luxury at Milestone Residences by Axiom. The Axiom Prime Real Estate Development project features modern 1 to 2 bedroom and 2 bedroom + maid apartments designed for those who desire to live in harmony with urban convenience and natural beauty. The ground floor will be dedicated to retail services in the building.

The interior of the building will be a blend of natural elements with contemporary design. The developer has crafted each residence with style, providing a distinctive living experience in the heart of the Jumeirah Village Triangle. The property will also have a rooftop swimming pool offering panoramic vistas, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and a podium level with many amenities.

location_tile.title: A Modern Low-Rise Tower in Jumeirah Village Triangle
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Milestone Residences is located in the Jumeirah Village Triangle. JVT epitomizes contemporary living amidst lush green landscapes and modern amenities. With its well-planned infrastructure and array of recreational facilities, including parks, sports fields, and community centers, JVT provides residents with a vibrant lifestyle. 

  • 10 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 14 Minutes to Jumeirah Golf Estate
  • 20 Minutes to the Mall of the Emirates
  • 25 Minutes to DXB Airport
  • 25 Minutes to  Al Maktoum Airport
